python.imports:
import fluentqt
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout
python.setup:
trigger = fluentqt.Button("Show Popup", %PARENT%)
trigger.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Accent)
trigger.setFixedSize(136, 32)
trigger.move(132, 104)
trigger.show()
control = fluentqt.Popup(%PARENT%)
control.setAnimationEnabled(False)
control.setLightDismissConsumesPress(True)
layout = QVBoxLayout(control)
layout.setContentsMargins(24, 20, 24, 20)
layout.setSpacing(8)
header = QHBoxLayout()
header.setSpacing(8)
heading = fluentqt.Label("Quick note", control)
heading.setFluentTypography(fluentqt.FontRole.BodyStrong)
header.addWidget(heading, 1)
close_button = fluentqt.Button(control)
close_button.setAccessibleName("Close popup")
close_button.setIconGlyph(fluentqt.Typography.Icons.ChromeClose)
close_button.setFluentLayout(fluentqt.Button.ButtonLayout.IconOnly)
close_button.setFluentStyle(fluentqt.Button.ButtonStyle.Subtle)
close_button.setFixedSize(28, 28)
header.addWidget(close_button)
layout.addLayout(header)
body = fluentqt.Label("Click outside, press Esc, or use the close button to dismiss.", control)
body.setWordWrap(True)
body.setTextColorRole(fluentqt.Label.TextColorRole.Secondary)
layout.addWidget(body)
control.resize(296, 134)
close_button.clicked.connect(control.close)
trigger.clicked.connect(control.open)
control.open()
